results.title: Add prompt opens an editable row at the top of the table

steps.title: Given the user is on the Prompts step
steps.expected: The prompt table and Add prompt are displayed

steps.title: When the user clicks Add prompt
steps.expected: An editable row opens at the top of the table

steps.title: Then the row holds a text input and the category, type and market selects
steps.expected: Text input, Category select, Type select and Market select are displayed

steps.title: And the row holds confirm and cancel
steps.expected: Confirm and cancel controls are displayed on the row

results.notes: Session A: Decathlon (decathlon.com), markets United Kingdom - English (EN) + France - French (FR) (GB (EN) / FR (FR) in the table), AI Insights English (EN). Discovery (about 2 s) returned "Sporting Goods" (FR "Articles de sport") and "Outdoor Gear" (FR "Équipement de plein air") = C1 and C2, nothing removed. Generate Prompts (about 5 s): 140 rows, ring "710 / 1000 prompts · 140 selected". Add prompt opened one row (data-testid wizard-prompt-draft-row) as the first row of the table: text input "New prompt" (wizard.promptTable.ariaNewPrompt, maxlength 300, focused), Category select, Type select, Market select (GB (EN)), confirm "Add this prompt" (wizard.promptTable.ariaConfirmDraft, check icon, disabled while the text is empty) and Cancel (X). The keep checkbox of the row is ticked and disabled. Observation (flag ON, GEO-1247 AC3): Category and Type show the text "Other" in grey; the Radix triggers carry data-placeholder, i.e. no value is selected and "Other" is the placeholder (wizard.promptTable.categoryOther / typeOther).

results.title: Only one new row at a time and cancel leaves the table unchanged

steps.title: Given the user has opened a new row and typed a prompt
steps.expected: The new row is at the top with the typed text
steps.data: Prompt: "Which brand makes the lightest tents?"

steps.title: When the user clicks Add prompt again
steps.expected: No second row opens; the focus goes back to the open row with its text

steps.title: And the user clicks cancel
steps.expected: The new row closes

steps.title: Then the table is unchanged
steps.expected: Same number of rows and same "N selected" and ring value as before Add prompt

results.notes: Same session. Before Add prompt: 140 rows, "710 / 1000 prompts · 140 selected". Row opened, "Which brand makes the lightest tents?" typed: 141 rows (1 draft at the top). Focus moved away, Add prompt clicked again: still exactly 1 draft row (141 rows), focus back on the draft text input (wizard-prompt-draft-row-text-input) with the typed text intact; Add prompt stays enabled. Cancel: draft closed, 140 rows, ring "710 / 1000 prompts · 140 selected", no row with "lightest tents".

results.title: Category and market selects list only the analysis values, market prefilled

steps.title: Given the user has opened a new row with Add prompt
steps.expected: The new row is at the top; Category and Type are empty

steps.title: When the user opens the category select
steps.expected: Only C1 and C2 are listed, with no Add category action

steps.title: And the user opens the market select
steps.expected: Only GB (EN) and FR (FR) are listed; the select is prefilled with GB (EN), the first market of the analysis

steps.title: When the user picks type Brand Image
steps.expected: The category select is cleared and disabled and shows "Overview"

results.notes: Same session, no filter. Given: new row at the top, but Category and Type are not visibly empty: both show "Other" (grey placeholder text, wizard.promptTable.categoryOther / typeOther; the triggers carry data-placeholder so no value is selected). This is the GEO-1247 AC3 behaviour with the unbranded flag ON; the CSV expects "empty", so the TC is marked PARTIAL and needs a QA decision (see CSV wording proposal). Category select opened: exactly 2 options "Sporting Goods" and "Outdoor Gear" (C1, C2), no Add category action, no "Other" option. Market select: exactly "GB (EN)" and "FR (FR)", prefilled and selected "GB (EN)" (first market). The Type select lists Visibility, Reputation, Competitive, Brand Image and Other. Type Brand Image picked: Category shows "Overview" (wizard.promptTable.overview) and is disabled (disabled + data-disabled, no placeholder any more).

results.notes: Same session. Market column menu: GB (EN) 70, FR (FR) 70; FR (FR) ticked: 70 rows, all FR (FR). Add prompt: new row at the top, Market = "FR (FR)" (prefilled from the single-market filter), so the market part passes. "Category and Type stay empty": both show "Other" (grey placeholder, data-placeholder set, no value selected; wizard.promptTable.categoryOther / typeOther), GEO-1247 AC3 with the flag ON, not visibly empty, so PARTIAL. Filter cleared afterwards. Extra check (not in the TC): with a text typed and Category/Type left on "Other", confirm "Add this prompt" is enabled (consistent with GEO-1247 AC3); draft cancelled, nothing added.

results.title: A confirmed prompt is kept, highlighted and marked CUSTOM

steps.title: Given the user has filled a new row
steps.expected: Confirm is enabled; ring reads "X / P"
steps.data: Prompt: "Which brand sells the best kayaks" - Category C2 - Type Competitive - Market GB (EN)

steps.title: When the user confirms
steps.expected: The toast "Prompt added. It uses one pool slot." is shown

steps.title: Then the row is added kept and highlighted
steps.expected: The row is ticked, highlighted, at the top of the table; the ring reads "X + 1 / P"

steps.title: And the row is marked with a CUSTOM badge
steps.expected: CUSTOM badge on the row; the wording ends with "?"

steps.title: When the user performs the next action on the table
steps.expected: The highlight is removed; the CUSTOM badge stays

results.notes: Same session, X = 710, P = 1000 ("710 / 1000 prompts · 140 selected"). Row filled: "Which brand sells the best kayaks" (no "?"), Category Outdoor Gear (C2), Type Competitive, Market GB (EN) (prefilled); confirm enabled. Confirm: toast "Prompt added. It uses one pool slot." (wizard.promptTable.promptAdded, role=status, data-testid wizard-prompt-added-toast). New row first in the table, ticked (data-kept=true), highlighted (data-highlighted=true, background #eff6ff), wording "Which brand sells the best kayaks?" with "?" added, CUSTOM badge (data-testid wizard-prompt-row-custom-badge-<id>), ring "711 / 1000 prompts · 141 selected". Next action Sort Category ascending (first rows Outdoor Gear): highlight removed (data-highlighted=false, white background), CUSTOM badge still on the row, still ticked (step3b_after_sort).

steps.expected: E is listed

steps.title: When the user adds E again in upper case with extra spaces and without "?" for the same category, type and market
steps.expected: An error is shown and the row is not added
steps.data: Wording of E in upper case, double spaces, no "?"; C1; Visibility; GB (EN)

steps.title: And the user changes the market of the new row to FR (FR) and confirms
steps.expected: The prompt is added for FR (FR) with the CUSTOM badge

results.notes: Same session. E = "Best Sporting Goods?" - Sporting Goods (C1) - Visibility - GB (EN), listed once. New row: "BEST  SPORTING  GOODS" (upper case, double spaces, no "?"), Sporting Goods, Visibility, GB (EN): inline error "This prompt already exists for this market, category and type." (wizard.promptTable.duplicatePrompt, role=alert, data-testid wizard-prompt-draft-row-error), input aria-invalid=true, confirm disabled, row not added (ring still "711 / 1000 · 141 selected", E still the only Best Sporting Goods row). Market changed to FR (FR): error gone, confirm enabled; confirm gives the toast "Prompt added. It uses one pool slot.", row added at the top for FR (FR), Sporting Goods, Visibility, with the CUSTOM badge, ticked, highlighted, wording "BEST  SPORTING  GOODS?" ("?" added, case and double spaces kept as typed), ring "712 / 1000 prompts · 142 selected".

steps.title: When the user types 249 characters
steps.expected: No counter is shown

results.notes: Same session. New row: input empty, no counter. 249 characters: length 249, no counter. One more character typed (250): counter "250 / 300" shown (wizard.promptTable.lengthCounter). 300 characters then 2 more typed key by key: value stays at 300, counter "300 / 300"; a 301-character fill is also cut to 300 (input maxlength=300); no error message shown. Draft cancelled.
